name: Vision Inspector

width.label: Clear width (m)
width.desc: The gap between the two columns, across the direction of travel. Wider than the conveyor, so the columns stand clear of its legs.

surfaceHeight.label: Conveyor height (m)
surfaceHeight.desc: Height of the conveying surface under the arch: the bottom of the read zone.

clearance.label: Clearance (m)
clearance.desc: From the conveying surface up to the camera head. The tallest load must pass under it; the read zone fills that height.

readDepth.label: Read depth (m)
readDepth.desc: How far along the direction of travel (local Z) the read window reaches, centred under the head. A case is inspected as it crosses the scan line once its CENTRE is in the window.

expectedAngle.label: Expected angle (deg)
expectedAngle.desc: How a good case is turned, measured from the direction of travel to the case's length axis, + turning left seen from above. 0 is a case lying along the belt, 90 a case lying across it.

tolerance.label: Tolerance (deg)
tolerance.desc: How far from the expected angle a case may be turned and still pass, either way.

symmetry.label: Case symmetry

options.label: Looks the same every half turn (box)

symmetry.desc: Which turns of the case the camera cannot tell apart. A plain rectangular case is the same after a half turn, so one turned 180 degrees passes. Choose the last for a product whose front must face forward: its front is the case's own +X end.

showBeam.label: Show scan line
showBeam.desc: Draw the scan line across the conveyor. A viewing aid only.

beamColor.label: Beam color
beamColor.desc: Paint of the crossbeam the head hangs from.

doneTag.label: Inspected tag (pulse)
doneTag.desc: Goes true for a quarter of a second each time a case is inspected. Take its rising edge to read the result tags.

okTag.label: Rotation OK tag
okTag.desc: The last verdict: true when the case was within tolerance, false when it was turned too far. Set on the same scan the inspected pulse rises, and held until the next case.

angleTag.label: Deviation tag (deg)
angleTag.desc: How far the last case was from the expected angle, in degrees, + turned left. Within plus or minus half the symmetry turn.

countTag.label: Inspected count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of cases inspected this run.

rejectCountTag.label: Rejected count tag
rejectCountTag.desc: Running total of cases that failed the rotation check this run.
